title: Asparagus and Ukrainian White Wrap
description: A keto-friendly wrap filled with sautéed asparagus, zesty Ukrainian sausage, and creamy white sauce.
instructions: Wrap asparagus in foil and roast for 10-12 minutes, or until tender.
Cook Ukrainian sausage in a pan over medium-high heat, breaking up into small pieces, until browned.
Add garlic and parsley to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in white sauce and cook for an additional minute.
Warm the white wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the sausage mixture on the wrap, followed by roasted asparagus.
